delegatedScopes.name: User.Read
delegatedScopes.purpose: Read the signed-in operator identity and direct memberships used by the readiness check.

delegatedScopes.name: Domain.Read.All
delegatedScopes.purpose: Read verified tenant domains for tenant and SharePoint discovery.

delegatedScopes.name: RoleManagement.Read.Directory
delegatedScopes.purpose: Read the signed-in operator's directory-role membership and role display names.

delegatedScopes.name: Sites.Read.All
delegatedScopes.purpose: Resolve the configured SharePoint site and enumerate its document libraries.

azure.roleRationale: Contributor deploys subscription and resource-group resources but cannot create the managed-identity Key Vault role assignment. The second role supplies Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write. Owner supplies both capabilities.

network.proxyBehavior: Uses the Windows, .NET, MSAL, Az PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph PowerShell networking stacks; the installer has no independent proxy bypass or certificate-trust store.

localData.purpose: Preview, deployment, validation, removal, portal-status, outbox, report, and final-evidence artifacts

allowed: resource names, IDs, locations, tags, states, and deployment outcomes
configured SharePoint site URL, site ID, and document-library metadata
package hashes, deployment export ID, event IDs, sequence, status, outcome, and sanitized error summaries
